title: silver-crest-bank-integration-call-notes-2026-07-20
content:
Call notes: Silver Crest Bank (SCB) - private deployment discovery (2026-07-20)
Attendees: Asha (RWD SE), Michael (RWD infra), Sofia (RWD PM), Rajiv (SCB CTO), Lina (SCB infra), Tom (SCB security)

High level
- Goal: Private (VPC) deployment in AWS us-east-1 for customer-facing assistant + secure batch embeddings for search
- Hard constraints: data residency (US only), KMS integration with customer-managed keys, SOC2/PCI considerations for PII
- Expected QPS: 50 concurrent requests peak, mostly short chats (avg seq len ~ 256 tokens), occasional long jobs (>=2048)

SLA / performance
- Target p95 latency < 300ms for single-shot generate (chat turn <=512 tokens)
- Throughput target: sustain ~2000 tokens/sec with headroom for peak batch jobs
- Must support graceful fallback to hosted models in event of capacity loss (they prefer on-prem first, but allow fallback for DR)

Security & network
- SCB requires no egress to public internet from private subnet except to Redwood control plane via mTLS over specific endpoints
- IDS/IPS in front of subnets; need outbound allowlist for control plane + metrics endpoints
- KMS key rotation policy: quarterly; customer will manage CMKs, require IAM role trust from Redwood account
- HSM optional (they may request later for highest-sensitivity flows)

Integration gotchas / risks
- VPN vs Direct Connect: SCB prefers AWS Direct Connect due to throughput requirements; timeline TBD, but rollout will be gated on link availability
- Persistent KV cache: must verify separation per-tenant, encryption at rest using customer CMK; otherwise they will push for separate dedicated GPUs
- Model quantization: SCB legal wants assurance that quantized weights don't leak training data - need to prepare short explainer + security review
- Logging: they require obfuscated logs for PII; we need to supply log scrubbing rules and sample logs

Open questions
- Which models to certify? SCB asks for 2 options: Llama2-13B-8bit and an RWD-curated 70B quantized variant - cost/latency tradeoffs needed
- Can we support burst capacity for batch re-indexing jobs without exposing additional egress? (Michael to confirm autoscale network config)
- Who signs the KMS IAM policy? SCB legal vs SCB infra (ownership unclear)

Action items / next steps
- Asha: write short security explainer about quantization + model data leakage risks; due 2026-07-23
- Michael: validate autoscale + Direct Connect impacts and prepare network allowlist (by 2026-07-27)
- Sofia: draft proposal with two model options, cost delta, expected latency numbers (2026-07-24)
- Rajiv/Lina (SCB): share architecture diagram and list of required ports/endpoints for firewall (requested by 2026-07-22)
- Set up follow-up call after DC confirmation - target week of 2026-07-28

Notes to self
- Prep demo: show fallback to hosted and canary rollback (good selling point)
- Flag legal for KMS policy template and DP-privacy team for log-scrubbing checklist
- Slack thread created: #cust-scb-integration

Quick refs
- JIRA: SE-1123 (integration epic)
- Confluence: SilverCrest-Private-Deploy (design doc) - ask PM to link
- GH PR: rwd-deployments PR/789 (example infra configs)

Rough timeline
- Discovery complete -> config signoff within 2-3 weeks after DC availability
- Pilot (1 region) target: end of Q3 2026

-- end of notes --
